biography: Tim Child, a name whispered with respect and a touch of apprehension in the Caterham Academy paddock, hails from the quaint village of Silverstone, a stone's throw from the legendary circuit. Growing up, the roar of engines was his lullaby, and the scent of burning rubber, his perfume. Unlike most racers who start young, Tim's journey began relatively late, at 19, after a karting 'arrive and drive' session with friends revealed an uncanny aptitude. He wasn't the fastest out of the box, but his methodical approach and unwavering focus quickly set him apart. His defining moment came in his second Caterham season at Oulton Park. Battling torrential rain and treacherous conditions, Tim, against all odds, flawlessly executed a daring last-lap overtake, cementing his reputation as a 'calculating' driver. Now at 28, Tim is considered to be at his peak, currently participating in the Caterham Graduates Championship. He is constantly seeking ways to improve his already impressive skills.
drivingStyle: Tim's driving style is a masterclass in precision and risk assessment. He's not the flashiest, nor the most aggressive driver, but he's relentlessly consistent. He meticulously studies track data, identifying optimal braking points and cornering lines. He's known for his exceptional tire management, often nursing his rubber to the end of a stint while others fade. In high-pressure situations, Tim remains ice-cold, rarely cracking under pressure, a trait that makes him a formidable opponent in wheel-to-wheel combat.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about raw speed; it's about understanding the equation and solving it faster than anyone else."
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham Roadsport Championship in 2021 after a season-long battle, securing the title with a dominant performance in the final race at Donington Park.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure in the final race of the 2020 Caterham Academy Championship while leading, costing him the championship by a single point.
